incidents.name: DeltaPrime
incidents.notes: reentrancy via claimReward with fake pair double-counted collateral/reward in SmartLoan

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x62cf82fb0484af382714cd09296260edc1dc0c6c is the DeltaPrime SmartLoanDiamondBeacon, an EIP-2535 diamond that changes facet code with DiamondCut rather than an EIP-1967 Upgraded event; eth_getLogs over creation block 119095598 (2023-08-07) to incident block 273278742 returns 150 DiamondCut logs, the last four of them on 2024-11-07 (12:28:11, 12:28:47, 12:29:18 and 12:29:48 UTC) replacing Penpie/Pendle facets; the final cut, block 271974869 / tx 0xdd4a56e87ca82cda4f184a4f57f27f3f1af2ea4ea521cd7fe03f691e9b50684a, Replaces facet 0x130c975a189024cdfe4a4b38706a431463ad0acf (PenpieFacet) carrying claimRewards(address) 0xef5cfb8c, the selector the exploit reentered, so the age is measured from that cut rather than the beacon deployment

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-11-07T12:29:48Z (block 271974869, tx 0xdd4a56e87ca82cda4f184a4f57f27f3f1af2ea4ea521cd7fe03f691e9b50684a): last DiamondCut on the SmartLoanDiamondBeacon before the incident, a Replace of PenpieFacet 0x130c975a189024cdfe4a4b38706a431463ad0acf that reinstalled claimRewards(address) (0xef5cfb8c), the exploited selector
